name: superpowers-strigov-ver
description: Personal fork of superpowers for strigov: multi-model dev orchestrator on the GPT-5.6 family — Sonnet main thread orchestrates (triage, dispatching, polling, git); an Opus subagent at max thinking effort writes the plan and its authorized revisions; Codex Sol max reviews the plan (loop cap=4, fresh task each round, --effort ultra strictly user-initiated); Opus invoked as subagent for code-review judgment (4.1); Fable subagent as judgment escalation tier (spec/ADR writing in brainstorming, 4.1 on high-risk phases or round 3+, BLOCKED diagnosis, impasse summaries; explicit Opus fallback); Codex Luna max implements with Terra xhigh as reasoning escalation; Codex Sol xhigh runs a control review on diffs after Opus review clears (fused loop cap=4). Reviewers consume a pre-baked review package (bin/review-package) and implementers report to files; a final whole-branch Opus review gates plan completion (cap=2). Sonnet verification gate (lint/typecheck/affected tests) runs before every review round; multi-round reviews are consolidated into docs/reviews/ by a synthesis step. Codex resumes are thread-addressed via the vendored companion's --resume-task extension. Plans are written to docs/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md with YAML frontmatter for cross-session resume. Auto-commits on clean review. Routes trivial edits to Sonnet quickfix subagent. Plus codex-invocation recipe, codex-ask (advisory second opinion), architecture-memory (ARCHI.md), and selected upstream skills (brainstorming, writing-plans, systematic-debugging, TDD, worktrees, verification-before-completion, finishing-a-development-branch, code-review flow, writing-skills, dispatching-parallel-agents).
